svg.title: HISD Ribbon — fan divider band
svg.desc: The SECONDARY ribbon recipe — a thin multi-color "fan" divider band. FIXED canonical 4 stops, identical everywhere a fan appears (teal first, per brand): teal #00A3AF @ 0%, light-green #6DB83D @ 38%, yellow #F9D04E @ 64%, purple #474F99 @ 100%. Never themed, never re-ordered. Decorative only: role="img" + aria-hidden; host with alt="" / role="presentation". Hex are the flattened canonical fan stops so the file renders standalone (print/email/no-CSS).
